dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses ORCMCPSUB DB access pattern and COPY-based file layouts typical of ORCA system.
evidence: COPY MCPAREA / CPORCMCP / ORCMCPSUB CALL pattern
EXIT PROGRAM / STOP RUN conditional on SHELLID

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) billing system - provisional receipt data creation component
purpose.summary: ORCR0600 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates provisional receipt (kari-shunyu) data. It reads patient information, insurance combination records, medical accounting records, and hospitalization accounting records, then generates receipt billing data for health insurance claims. It supports both regular and realtime-preview processing modes.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (26 copybooks) for record layouts
63 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCMCPSUB, ORCSJOB, etc.)
144 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
Conditional STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM based on SHELLID
OCCURS clauses for table handling (insurance day tables, system master tables)
DB access via ORCMCPSUB with DBSELECT/DBCLOSECURSOR function codes
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - proprietary DB middleware used instead
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comment text. Source is truncated to 16000 chars of 93428 bytes total (about 17%). Program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 chars (7 long lines noted).
